rationale: Substantial procedural convergence (joint independent auditor, board-minuted pause, numerical triggers, dividend sequencing) has been achieved, but the core substantive fault lines—whether a structural shortfall reopens closures/redundancies, the actual magnitude of ownership sacrifice, and irrevocability of guarantees—remain genuinely contested with parties sharpening rather than resolving their positions. Since the audit itself hasn't occurred yet, these disagreements are testable and likely to shift once numbers arrive, so further rounds are warranted rather than closure.
